policies: Discovery starts from provider-native localized name queries and never from snorlax_cards.json, units.json, or the legacy Cardmarket candidate list.
Every fetched detail record is retained before identity matching and reaches exactly one visible accounting bucket.
Raw set codes and collector numbers remain unchanged; a reviewed symbol reading is an additive assertion, never a rewrite.
A changed identifier creates an equivalence proposal and cannot overwrite or merge a physical-print identity.
Zero results, incomplete pagination, rate limits, and parse failures are source failures or needs-evidence states, never evidence of absence.
No discovery adapter may write a confirmation, contradiction, finish verdict, or owner adjudication.
